title: Wrong Host Mapping
description: A workspace-local hosts override maps api.internal to an obsolete address, causing connection failures.
mission: Use the provided DNS evidence to correct api.internal in etc/hosts.override to 127.0.0.1.
success: The workspace host override now uses the correct address.

lesson.what_happened: A local host override took precedence over the expected service address.
other_solutions: Remove the stale override if normal DNS is available
lesson.be_careful: This Scene never changes the system /etc/hosts file.

hints: Local hosts mappings can override DNS results.
Edit only the workspace-local etc/hosts.override file.
